fields.description: Send an Expo push to the user's TBO Smart devices for each new notification on this site.
fields.label: Mobile push

fields.description: Let the TBO Smart app sign in with a Microsoft (Entra ID) account and get this site's own tokens for the matching user.
fields.label: Single sign-in with Microsoft

fields.description: Directory (tenant) ID of TBO's Entra ID, a GUID. Separate several with commas.
fields.label: Microsoft tenant ID

fields.description: Application (client) ID of the TBO Smart mobile app registration in Entra ID.
fields.label: Mobile Entra client ID

fields.description: The TBO Smart OAuth Client. Tokens from single sign-in are issued for it, so refresh and revoke work as usual.
fields.label: OAuth Client
